sn46.33:1.1: Pañcime bhikkhave jātarūpassa upakkilesā || Yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭham jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti || na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaram pabhāṅgu ca na ca sammā upeti kammāya || || Katame pañca || || Ayo bhikkhave jātarūpassa upakkileso || yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaram pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā upeti kammāya || || Loham bhikkhave jātarūpassa upakkileso || yena upakkilesena uppakkiliṭṭham jātarūpaṃ || la-pe || || Tipu bhikkhave jātarūpassa upakkileso || la [pe] || || Sīsam bhikkhave jātarūpassa upakkileso || la-pe || || Sajjhum bhikkhave jātarūpassa upakkileso yena upakkilesena uppakkiliṭṭham jātarūpam na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaram pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā upeti kammāya || || Ime kho bhikkhave pañca jātarūpassa uppakkilesā yehi {upakkilesehi} uppakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti || na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaram pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā upeti kammāya || ||
sn46.33:2.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave pañcime cittassa upakkilesā || || yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ na ceva mudu hoti || na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaram pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā samādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāya || || Katame pañca || || Kāmacchando bhikkhave cittassa upakkileso || yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyam na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā sammādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāya || || 10--13. || la || Ime kho bhikkhave pañca cittassa upakkilesā || yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittam na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaram pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā samādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāyā ti || ||
